backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Post, Comment, Poll, Message, Group, Notification, LocalIssue, PoliticalDiscussion, Report, etc.) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization with access control state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of hierarchical location selector improvements including scrollable dropdowns, search/filter functionality, cascading selection behavior, and mobile-responsive touch-friendly scrolling across all location fields.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including App.tsx with routing, query hooks, UI components (Header, PostCard, CreatePostCard, etc.), pages (HomePage, ProfileView, MessagesPage), and styling with OKLCH colors and mobile optimizations.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documentation explaining Android branding assets (app icon, adaptive icon foreground/background, splash screen) stored in frontend/public/assets/generated/ and how they're used to generate Android native resources for Capacitor builds.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Guide for building production-ready Android App Bundle (AAB) for Google Play Store submission, covering prerequisites, signing key creation, and build process steps.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for Android build artifacts, IDE files, keystore files, NDK objects, profiler outputs, signing files, and OS-specific files to prevent committing sensitive or generated content.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Documentation-only README explaining Android keystore purpose, creation using keytool, and security best practices with explicit warning not to commit actual keystore files to version control.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration for CivWorld Android app defining app ID, web directory, server settings with ICP domain allowlist, Android-specific settings, and splash screen plugin configuration.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tags for mobile support, tap highlight prevention, and root div mounting point for React application loaded via main.tsx module script.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Bash script automating Android build process: builds web app with pnpm, syncs to Android via Capacitor, and builds either debug APK or release AAB with signing validation and output instructions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application entry point that sets up React Router with TanStack Router, React Query client, and defines all route configurations. Includes layout component with header, navigation, profile setup modal, and Capacitor Internet Identity shim installation.
Shim that intercepts window.open calls for Internet Identity authentication in Capacitor Android WebView and redirects them to the Capacitor Browser plugin for proper authentication flow.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Documentation for building CivWorld as an Android app using Capacitor, listing prerequisites including Android Studio, JDK 17+, and setup instructions.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Platform detection utilities providing safe functions to check if running in Capacitor environment and identify the platform (iOS, Android, or web).
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Troubleshooting guide for debugging Internet Identity authentication issues specifically in the Android Capacitor build.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: Dashboard component displaying analytics metrics (posts, likes, comments, followers, poll votes) and top posts, with support for personal or global variant views.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Component that renders user achievement badges with tooltips, supporting different sizes and configurable maximum display count with overflow indicator.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile with icons and labels for Home, Video, Reel, Events, and Wallet routes, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/BuildInfoIndicat: Small component displaying the current build ID with a code icon, useful for debugging and version tracking.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Chat interface component for direct messaging between users, displaying conversation history with timestamps, user avatars, and message input with send functionality.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: Modal dialog component for creating new civic discussions with fields for title, context, region, and category selection. Handles form submission via useCreateDiscussion hook and resets state on success or close.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: Modal dialog for creating political groups/parties with name, description, and optional cover image upload. Includes upload progress tracking and uses ExternalBlob for image handling.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: Modal for creating posts within a group, supporting text content and optional image uploads with preview. Handles image upload progress and validates that either text or image is provided.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: Card component for creating posts with text, image, or video content. Includes file validation, preview functionality, upload progress tracking, and authentication/actor availability checks before submission.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: Modal dialog for editing existing posts, allowing updates to text, image, and video content. Initializes with current post data and handles media file replacement with preview and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: Modal dialog component for editing user profile information including name, bio, and location using a hierarchical location selector. Fetches current profile data and saves updates via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: Modal dialog for uploading, processing, and managing user profile pictures with validation, cropping, compression, and upload progress tracking. Supports removing existing photos and displays preview before saving.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header component with authentication controls, navigation buttons (wallet, explore, notifications, messages), and a notifications popover showing unread count. Handles login/logout and navigation to various routes.
frontend/src/components/HierarchicalLoca: Cascading location selector component with searchable dropdowns for country, state, district, MP constituency, MLA constituency, mandal, and village. Loads location data hierarchically and supports initial location parsing.
frontend/src/components/HorizontalNav.ts: Horizontal navigation bar with tabs for Discussions, Polls, and My Constituency sections. Highlights active tab based on current route and provides icon-based navigation.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Card component displaying a social media post with like, comment, share, and menu actions. Supports post deletion, editing, reporting, and shows author profile with badges and verification status.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new user profile setup with fields for name, bio, and hierarchical location selection. Prevents closing until profile is created.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: Component for creating posts with text, image, or video content. Handles file uploads, validation, and submission with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: Modal for reporting posts, comments, or profiles with predefined reasons (spam, misinformation, harassment, etc.) and optional details field.
Displays trending hashtags in a scrollable horizontal list with click handling and shimmer animation on data refresh.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: Renders a verified checkmark icon with tooltip in configurable sizes (sm/md/lg) for verified accounts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication state and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching hierarchical location data (countries, states, districts, MP/MLA constituencies, mandals, villages) from the backend actor, with caching and conditional enabling based on parent selections.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines comprehensive React Query hooks and mutations for all app features including user profiles, posts, comments, groups, messages, notifications, polls, reports, learning modules, local issues, and political discussions with proper cache invalidation and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, removes tap highlights for mobile, styles form elements and scrollbars, and includes z-index fixes for modals and dropdowns.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the App component with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: Page component for creating a new page with form fields for name, category, description, visibility, verification request, and image uploads; currently shows a placeholder message as backend functionality is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: Form page for creating polls with question, 2-6 options, and public/private visibility toggle; validates inputs, checks authentication, and uses the createPoll mutation to submit data.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays a feed of all posts with an integrated CreatePostCard component at the top; shows loading state, empty state, or list of PostCard components sorted by timestamp.
frontend/src/pages/EducationPage.tsx: File appears to be empty or contains only whitespace.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: A placeholder page displaying a 'Coming Soon' message for political events and campaigns feature, showcasing planned functionality like event creation, RSVP system, location-based search, and event reminders.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Displays trending posts, active groups, and analytics in a tabbed interface, calculating trending content based on likes/comments in the last 24 hours and showing group activity metrics.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific group including cover image, description, member count, join button, and group posts, with the ability to create new posts if the user is a member.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsAndPagesPage.ts: A combined page with tabs for Groups and Pages, displaying user's groups and all available groups, with buttons to create new groups or pages.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Displays all groups and user's joined groups in separate tabs, with navigation to group details and a button to create new pages.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main feed page with tabs for public posts and news feed, supporting hashtag filtering, news post creation for admins/verified users, and sorting options. Includes QuickPostBar, PostCard components, and TrendingSection.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Direct messaging page that allows users to start conversations by entering a Principal ID and displays a ChatWindow component for active conversations.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Local civic engagement page for reporting constituency issues with image upload, tracking issue status (new/in-review/resolved), and monitoring political promises.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Placeholder page for creating and managing public pages for organizations and communities, currently showing a 'coming soon' message with navigation to page creation.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Polls listing and voting page with filters (trending/latest/local/state/national), category badges, vote percentage display, and poll creation navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page displaying avatar, bio, badges, verified status, and tabs for posts/analytics with modals for editing profile and profile picture.
frontend/src/pages/ReelPage.tsx: Placeholder page showing a 'coming soon' message for short-form vertical video content feature focused on civic engagement.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: Page for creating content (posts, events, videos) with CreatePostCard component and placeholder cards for upcoming event and video upload features. Navigates to home after successful post creation via custom 'postCreated' event.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Displays all posts containing a specific hashtag from URL params, with header showing post count and a button to start discussions. Filters posts by exact hashtag match in text content.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, bio, location, badges, verification status, follower/following counts, and user posts. Supports follow/unfollow actions, messaging, and reporting with authentication checks and own-profile detection.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: Placeholder page for upcoming video feed feature, displaying a centered coming-soon message with video icon.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Wallet page displaying CIV token balance (currently 0.00) with disabled send/receive buttons and a notice that wallet features are in development. Requires authentication to access.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Comprehensive TypeScript type definitions for the entire application including user profiles, posts, comments, polls, messages, groups, notifications, analytics, issues, discussions, reports, and education features with various enums for status and category types.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Utility functions for converting backend errors into user-friendly messages, with specific handling for traps, authentication, system readiness, and content validation errors. Includes helper functions to detect authentication and system-not-ready errors.
frontend/src/utils/buildId.ts: Extracts a build identifier from loaded script URLs (hashed filenames) or falls back to page load timestamp, useful for diagnosing stale-client issues after redeployment.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Utility functions for handling Candid optional values in MediaContent objects, including normalization, validation, and checking for valid text/image/video content.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Profile photo validation and processing utilities that validate file type/size (JPG/PNG, max 5MB) and process images by cropping to square and compressing to 800x800px.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing and management utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
frontend/WALLET_VISIBILITY_AUDIT.md: Audit checklist documenting the creation and integration of wallet features including WalletPage component, /wallet route, navigation entries in Header and BottomNav, build ID indicator, and deployment verification steps.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a Flutter app with hierarchical location selection (Country→State→District→MP→MLA→Mandal→Village) and known issues with dropdown scrolling, search functionality, and performance optimization needs.
